title: Adopt ruff format and blame ignore revs

demand.statement: Maintainers must adopt ruff format for Python under src, tests, and scripts. Scope is one formatting commit, a root .git-blame-ignore-revs file naming that commit, a CONTRIBUTING.md note for blame.ignoreRevsFile, a ruff format --check step on the existing CI lint job, and a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry. Out of scope: behavior changes, job renames, matrix changes, merging, and publishing.
